H3.claim: Every pressure-trained B seed has lower explicit transaction costs and higher net return than its paired original B under double-cost evaluation, without collapsing to a fixed action or no fills.

market_increment: Every D seed under both evaluation costs beats paired E and the best fixed 0/25/50 percent reference in return, with drawdown no greater than both references; retain the original v2 criterion.
legacy_gate_diagnostics: Every D seed under both costs: positive return, drawdown <= same-cost hold, >=2 actions, and fills. These are exploratory diagnostics, not future admission.
input_semantics: Unchanged native GoldEnv and frozen 2023 scaler. Training cost intervention includes the existing scenario-adjusted mark and endogenous cash, quantity and peak trajectories. Do not introduce a raw-bid observation adapter or attribute effects to one cost component.
artifact_identity: D/E are new study labels; native actor input arm remains B/C. Bind study version, protocol SHA, training costs and actor SHA in a separate manifest. Existing deployment/f64 evidence does not apply to these models.
selection: Run once, report every seed and failure; no seed selection, retry search, additional timesteps, reward or feature changes, 2025 evaluation, model registration, or account writes.
forward_confirmation: Not authorized by exploratory results. Requires separately frozen genuinely future dates, immutable same-source quotes, all control models/references, exact deployed-policy validation, and unchanged original qualification gates. No current model is approved.
